programs.name: Agricultural, Food and Environmental Policy Analysis (AFEPA)
programs.fieldOfStudy: Agricultural, Food and Environmental Policy Analysis (AFEPA)

requirements.sourceQuote: A Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent academic degree of minimum three years of undergraduate study corresponding to 180 ECTS credits with a grade of at least an overall average “B” or equivalent grade

A Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent academic degree of minimum three years of undergraduate study corresponding to 180 ECTS credits with a grade of at least an overall average “B” or equivalent grade
A minimum of 24 ECTS credits in economics gained in the Bachelor’s degree is also required–including one course each in microeconomics and statistics.

deadlines.dateText: The period for the submission of applications for the AFEPA programme for the 2027 cohort is from mid-October 2026 to mid-February 2027. For exact dates, consult our website in due time ([Application & Admission — AFEPA](https://www.ilr1.uni-bonn.de/afepa/en/application-admission)). Applicants from European countries can apply until 30 June 2027.
